environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 Web ACL with two rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) Priority 0: a custom rule group 'corp-input-validation' containing a RegexPatternSet rule matching request query string parameters against pattern `(?i)(?:union\s+(?:all\s+)?select|;\s*(?:drop|alter|insert|update|delete)|'\s*(?:or|and)\s+['"]?\w+['"]?\s*[=<>])` with action BLOCK and CloudWatch metric 'SQLiCustomBlock'; (2) Priority 1: AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with all rules set to BLOCK (no overrides to COUNT). The Web ACL default action is ALLOW. Additionally, the ECS task role has an IAM policy with a Deny statement on logs:CreateLogStream unless aws:SourceVpc matches the VPC ID, preventing exfiltration via out-of-band channels. The Fargate task runs in a private subnet with no NAT gateway or internet gateway route, egress is only to VPC endpoints (S3 gateway, CloudWatch Logs interface endpoint).
